title: Xerberus: Risk Ratings for all Fungible Assets on Cardano

ms.promise:
The output of our first milestone is a research paper that proposes a risk model for measuring risk associated with Cardano Native Assets. This risk model will look into the measurement of risk for a token, examining facets of risk including market risk, liquidity risk, network risk, and the potential impact of growth.
 • Price risk pertains to the risk primarily stemming from the market action of an asset.
 • Liquidity risk, as we define it, is the risk stemming from limited token allocation to liquidity pools.
 • Network Risk concerns the general network of holders. For instance, a token with a highly unequal distribution of tokens is likely to have greater network risk since a few holders can significantly influence the value of your position.
This research paper will explain how we plan to assess each of these components and the manner in which we'll balance these risks against each other. The model detailed in the paper will be foundational for the Xerberus Platform. Furthermore, the paper will be made public to foster an open discussion about the risk model.
ms.criteria: Was a research paper written that discusses the risk of tokens based on the three categories: Price Risk, Liquidity Risk, Network Risk? Additionally, do they discuss options to measure growth of a token?
ms.report:
The Proof of Achievement for Milestone 1 is the comprehensive research paper titled "Xerberus Protocol: Markowitz Risk Ratings" by Xerberus Labs Ltd. 
The paper meticulously details a risk model designed to measure various risks associated with Cardano Native Assets, addressing market risk, liquidity risk, network risk, and their impacts on token stability. It lays out methodologies for quantifying these risks and balancing them within the Xerberus Platform framework. This document serves as both a declaration of milestone completion and an invitation for open discussion within the decentralized finance community. 
Please find the research paper following this link: https://docsend.com/view/gx26nywt6ztch6pi

ms.promise: The output of this milestone will be a fully functioning web application. This web application will display the most prominent Cardano tokens and allow users to learn about the risks associated with these tokens. The risk displayed is directly based on the research submitted in the first milestone.The web app will feature a main page listing all the risk ratings as well as sub-pages that a user can use to explore the risk scores and observe them changing as events on the blockchain unfold. This means the milestone contains front-end, back-end, as well as connections to a Cardano node, all within a single milestone

ms.promise:
The output of the milestone is a research paper. In this research paper, we will use our risk scores and compare them with price data over time. The goal is to observe our risk ratings over time. We aim to determine the following: Do our risk ratings correlate with the performance of asset prices?
We will provide this analysis for every token in our database of about 200 different tokens. 
This milestone is pivotal for our project because it will determine if our risk model is fundamentally sound. Additionally, this backtesting report will guide the continued development of our model, highlighting its strengths and weaknesses. We will publish the paper to stimulate public debate about our risk scores and the merits upon which they are based.Our backtesting will also include the simulation of different alterations of the risk score itself. In order to create this backtesting, we will need to expand our server capacity significantly during this period to be able to run several models at once and compare them.
ms.criteria: Does the submitted research paper address whether the Xerberus Risk Ratings are fundamentally sound, based a data set of 200 tokens?
